_.what: a yield whose extension is NOT .md, so it is matched by the `.yield*` glob alone
_.why: the legacy glob `$stone*.md` masks the `.yield*` glob in every other fixture — both patterns match a `1.vision.yield.md`, so a break in either one still returns a file. this fixture is the only artifact that isolates the `.yield*` half, and it is what makes that half falsifiable.
